methods: HTTPS GET with 12s timeout and limited concurrency, redirects followed
HTTP status and page title only, not a semantic editorial assertion
Bot false-positive correction: normal pages with content title count as HTTP 2xx
Sources and action URLs deduplicated across records
limitations: HTTP 200 does not prove the content or present-day project operation
HTTP 403/5xx or certificate failure does not prove the Commons ceased existing
Stale/overdue projects are not marked reviewed by this technical audit
Existing historical source records and retrieval timestamps remain unchanged
